items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: And actually my idol, the great Louis Armstrong, was just about, you know, reaching his peak at that time.

ctx.x: Well who were the big men in the trumpet playing line?

In that time? One of the big men in those days in the trumpet line was the great Papa Celestein. He had a wonderful band at that time. And actually my idol, the great Louis Armstrong, was just about, you know, reaching his peak at that time. Did you listen to the record? You know, you remember Ken Rayner? I knew him. Yeah, well I used to listen to him. You know, I was very much inspired by him to be, on Sundays, this time of evening, you'd find them, they'd have a dance on Mondays, but they'd advertise it on…
